scenario: LFST.9 replay semantics — a replayer consumes recorded inputs in seq order and the engine re-produces its internal events (rule_lhs_facts / rule_fire_begin / rule_fire_end) and actions (action_log) identically. Pins that engine-internal and action events are reproduced, not replayed from the recording, and match byte-for-byte (the LFST.9.3.5 determinism proof).
rules_ds:
schema Trigger scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Derived scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule derive:
    Trigger t
->
    emit Derived logical v: t.v
